csv_project_name: CMAR Svc for Nancy Creek & Savoy Trail
csv_scope_of_work: City of Chamblee, Georgia (Owner) is requesting Statements of Qualifications from Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) firms (Proposer) for pre-construction services and the construction of the following Project: NANCY CREEK AND SAVOY TRAIL Owner will receive printed Statements of Qualifications demonstrating the Proposer s qualifications and ability to provide CMAR services and construct the Project at the Chamblee City Hall located at 3518 Broad Street, Chamblee, Georgia, until 10:00 A.M. local time, August 11, 2026. After that time, Owner will no longer accept Statements of Qualifications. See Requests for Qualifications for details on preparing and submitting the Statement of Qualifications.

references_qualifications: Proposers must submit statements of qualifications demonstrating their qualifications and ability to provide CMAR services and construct the project. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
award_criteria: Not specified in the notice excerpt; the request is for statements of qualifications for CMAR services.
